The 'Synthetic fibers' checkpoint is valid given the sheen. The classification of the object as a wig is supported by the visual evidence, despite the classifier's confusion with 'bonnet'.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly resembles a wig in style and coloration. Visually, the item functions as a wig, but the texture lacks the micro-detail of real hair, leaning towards a synthetic/AI-rendered appearance. 7/9 checkpoints passed/testable.
